title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am a government employee. Last week I got annual prize in terms of money and certificate. Is it halal to use? And I have donated this money to masjid. Is it ok? 2475 views Q. AA We receive house building loans equal to 36 months basic pay salary from university and return it in 120 installments with 4% administrative charges. Is it halal or not? 1453 views Q. I want to know 1- How to calculate Zakat on CPF( Central Provident Fund),CPF is like Employee Provident Fund.In CPF amount will be deposited from Employee salary deduction and company contribution. And CPF will be given at the time of retirement a) I understand Zakat is payable when we possess the money, Shall we calculate the zakat for all those year when money was getting deposited or for the year when we get the money ?? 2- How to calculate Zakat on Insurance Policies which will get mature in 25 years time (if I withdraw from policy no return will be given.)?Shall we pay zakat for every annual premium or only for the year when we get the money ? 3- How to calculate Zakat for Life Time policy( In life time policy fund will be invested in market and value can increase and decrease depending on market conditions), maturity date is after 25 years.This type of Policy has some surrender value if I want to withdraw from the policy. Do we need to pay when policy get mature or we are suppose to pay each year on surrender value or we need to pay at the time of maturity for every year. 4-Can we generalize the method of calculation for all the savings and Investments which get locked for certain period ? Should we calculate Zakat at the time of maturity of policy(liquidation of Investment) for that year only ?? or we should calculate zakat for all the previous year ?? or Shall we calculate each year? 3941 views Q. I am getting an itrest from my bank deposits which is being given to poors.I am a retired person and now trying to establish a business of wholesale medicine for which I need to take a drug licence.In order to get a drug licence a lot of money is required to be paid to different people as bribe.Can I pay this bribe money from the intrest earned from bank deposits. What is Islamic Fatwa for this. Kindly answer this for which I shall remain obliged. 1877 views Q. I'm serving as a Computer Operator in a government office. but I have no permanent post here. My salary are fixed and my duty time is 9.00AM to 5.00PM. But some officers work at 9.00AM to 8.00PM or more. 1866 views Q. Is it allowed for men to wear gold plated watches, which are not made of 100% gold? 5097 views Q. My question in regarding PPF. I was working for a companey for 4 years and they used to deduct PF from my salary every month based on my basic salary. For assumptions lets take my basic was 5ooo in first year then it became 10000 then next year 20000 and last year 25000 now this PF contribution was around 12% of my basic & I think the same amount was contributed by my companey & was given to PF office. after completion of my 4 years I left the companey and joined another companey. I calimed my PF and they deposited in my account . first cheque was of amount 180000/- and second was aroung 28000/-. Usually PF companey gives the interest of 8.5% and I want this interest money to be removed from my actual money. How do I do it ? I dont know how much is mine and companeys money and how much is interest given by Provident fund office. Please help. 1871 views Q. is gold plated items like ring ,watches etc. are allowed for men in islam? 4151 views Q. Assalamu Alaikum! This is a great service and may Allah ta'ala grant us all his Qurb. I work for a company whose owner is a Muslim and a Hafil, Aalim. It is an internet search engine. My questions are: 1) Is it okay for us to employ non Muslim women for work? 2) Is the income from such ghair mahrams and non Muslims halal for us. 3) Can you provide us if possible only a list of non-shariah compliant businesses? 4) Regarding the inclusion of pictures of people and living things, please update us on the Islamic view in this matter. Jazakallahu kahairan, May Allah ta'ala make this a cause for our spiritual progress. Your earliest response is expected. 1780 views Q. Assalamvalaikum..... My name is Sania,i have done Engineering and i m in a need of a job due to some financial problems in my home,and have got a job in a Central bank of india as Manager in Information Technology platform, i want to know sir that can i join for that post,according to islam i have heard that working in bam=nks is considered as illegal so i m asking you this question... please reply to me as soon as possible. 2360 views Q. We got proposal for my sister. The boy's father is manager in bank. As bank service is haram, so can we marry my sister to that boy, as he is grown up on his father money? They do have another business also but still his father is working in bank. 2560 views Q. Here in the UK, there are many 'theme parks' where there are many rides etc. Sometimes, Muslim Brothers/Muslim Sisters or even Muslim families go to these theme parks, especially during the summer to go for fun etc. My question is, is it permissable to go to these theme parks? The obvious thing is that there are men and women there, but here many Muslim families go regardless of the fact that there are both men and wmoen there. I would appreciate it if you could let us all know, so insha'Allah we can all have a clear message and pass it on to others. 3352 views Q. halal or haraam 2051 views Q. What is the punishment of seeing gair marham?jazakallahkhair 3803 views Q. Use of Haram Money 10394 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 32499 Country: India Title: what about transgender in islam? Question: what about transgender in islam Like nikah or social life etc. Answer ID: 32499 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 986/986/M=1432) According to Islam, becoming transgender (changing gender) is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
